conflicts.fact: Number and identity of the six chemicals of life
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 lists carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, vitamins, mineral salts, water (minerals separate, no nucleic acids). Lessons 2 and 6 list carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, vitamins/minerals (combined), water. Lesson 5 refers to 'nucleic acids, vitamins, and minerals' as separate items.

conflicts.fact: When and where the food tests (iodine, Biuret) on ugali/beans were performed
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 says the iodine and Biuret tests were done in Lesson 4 and uses a 'Lesson 4 food test results table'. Lesson 4 describes only reading, bottle-top models and food mapping with no food tests. Lesson 3 does only lipid tests. Lesson 6 also cites 'food test knowledge from Lesson 4'.

conflicts.fact: Whether chemical composition of foods was already known or tested in earlier lessons / what Lesson 1 and 2 do
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says no chemical tests and students only predict, and that the card sort is a first draft, yet Lesson 2 gives percentage composition data and a full explanation of kwashiorkor as protein deficiency, so Lesson 2 re-does the 'predict' entry as a new unit start (DQB 'created' in both Lessons 1 and 2).

conflicts.fact: Description of the ugali-eating child's deficiency/intake
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says ugali provides sufficient energy but insufficient (very little) protein (~2%). Lessons 4, 5, 6 say ugali provides no amino acids and no protein (Biuret negative). Lesson 6 also says 'carbohydrate excess'.

conflicts.fact: Whether the mandazi/other foods and lipids data are in ugali profile; ugali's lipid content
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 gives ugali ~1% fat, whereas Lesson 3 says ugali tested negative and is 'absent in lipids'.

conflicts.fact: Marasmus definition and phenomenon fit / menu in Lesson 6
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 defines marasmus as total caloric energy deficiency and says quantity matters less than composition; Lesson 6 menu includes fish and sukuma wiki yet asks which chemicals are 'missing', and Lesson 5 says model template has typically starred nucleic acids, vitamins, minerals, while Lesson 6 claims all six chemicals' structures were consolidated.
